title: Add missing alt attributes to images

params.name: dir
params.description: The directory to fix, relative to the repository root.

preconditions: The directory contains at least one or tag without an alt attribute.

criteria.pass: No or tag in the directory is missing alt, no images were removed, and the build script passes.
criteria.partial: Fewer tags are missing alt but some remain, images were removed, or the build fails.
criteria.fail: The number of tags missing alt did not drop.
